brief: Is an object that holds the value 1 and is equal to everything, as the passing counterpart of the null object.
detail: Its content is 1 and every comparison with it answers 1, whatever the other side is; its Where answers 0 because it has nothing to filter. TRUE(), TrueObject(), ATrueObject(), StzTrueQ() and StzTrueObjectQ() return one, and stzTrue is another name of the class. Build it without parentheses: new stzTrueObject.
